clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowthread Cave, Webwood Eggs lie in brooding nests in Shadowglen. Naturalists seek viable eggs to study the young spiders in secure laboratory conditions.

Researchers cannot safely tame or subdue a fully grown, venomous Webwood spider alone. Scholars like Gilshalan Windwalker instead collect unhatched eggs from clutches hidden in Shadowthread Cave. An egg can be carried safely, and the spiderlings contained when they hatch, giving naturalists live subjects to study without facing adult spiders’ deadly fangs.

Teldrassil’s native wildlife has grown unnaturally aggressive and corrupted, alarming scholars across the boughs. Eggs and gathered venoms secured at Aldrassil are bound for Darnassus. Researchers hope that raising and examining the spiders in controlled settings will reveal more about the dark affliction spreading through the World Tree’s boughs.
